scope: Independent source review of member Chat Store organization storage diagnostic
behavior_evidence: src/lib/org/active-org.ts persistSelection writes { id, name } under matrx.org.active; readStoredSelection accepts a stored object with a nonempty string id.
The diagnostic accepts a persisted object with a nonblank string id and rejects absent, primitive, empty, whitespace-only, and nonstring ids.
The acceptance driver records only storage-presence booleans from this diagnostic and asserts activeOrganizationPresent before proceeding to Chat or marking the receipt pass.
guard_evidence: The guard uses a valid persisted object and malformed variants, evaluates the generated browser expression, and rejects in-memory constant-true, constant-false, and string-only classifier mutations.
limits: This is a source and narrow-guard review; no native browser, member login, published Store artifact, or fresh acceptance receipt was exercised.
Storage shape alone does not prove live membership; the product resolver validates membership separately.
